venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Thursday 9/24 (MOD MKZ/JK; lower 70s, felt like first autumn).** Net $1,363 vs target $2,085 (-34.6%). Food $267, no event sales. Comps $29. 38 guests at $35.87 check average. Slower start to the evening, but the opener set the team up for success; hosted a stage getting to see how CC runs things. Thursday night football had guests intrigued watching the Falcons actually win for once — a big pop around 10:30pm filled the bar and booths through close, with some familiar faces and impressed first-timers. Negronis were a hit, especially the Spagett. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: industry regulars discovering the bar for the first time and promising to return every Thursday. Entered by Daniel.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Thursday 9/24 (MOD & Chef MD & KE / JMS; warm, overcast to clear).** Net $1,553 vs target $3,439 (-54.9%). Food $80. Comps $55.70 / 3.6% — trivia credit, industry, investor, F&F, Neuhoff employee. 53 guests at $29.30 check average. Steady Thursday night without a big influx, sustained throughout the evening; a notable number of guests watched Thursday football, including investor Preston. Peak volume around 9:45–10pm, closing out with industry and neighborhood regulars including Daisy and Jo from Fishmonger. Maintenance: Well 1 soda tap. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: a guest who celebrated his 30th at close on Tuesday came back just two nights later. Entered by BC.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: Cloudy and cold(er) — very Seattle weather
venues.narrative: **DVR — Thursday 9/24 (AM/PM Maggie S; cloudy and cold — very Seattle weather).** Total net sales including events $10,922 vs target $11,222 (-2.7%). DC/AM $1,012, D&C PM $7,534, Garden/6A $872; food including events $3,174 (event food $1,790), net event sales $2,372. Comps $154 — nothing unusual. 222 guests (Tock) at $49.19 check average. A sleepy, slow Thursday on the main floor — no big rushes, cut openers at 8:45pm, hosted down by 10pm, closed at 11pm with only three tables active per server and a full bar top. Garden was very slow; team folded towels and organized. Coffee bar work in the morning included brewing peach tea and tasting a new Honduras coffee. Evening included a small cocktail reception for CFR (15 guests, 6–8pm in Suite 6A) with passed apps and garden snacks — low-key, host thanked the team on the way out. No incidents; break make-up not yet complete. Favorite moment: a visit from Kira. Entered by MS.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Thursday 9/24 (MOD & Chef Kyler and Will; chillier).** Total EOD net $4,915 vs target $5,235 (-6.1%). Food $551, beverage $4,364. Comps $62.10. 138 guests (Sevenrooms), $36 check average. A well-paced, gorgeous flow of an evening — a nice bump around 8:30–9pm kept the room full until midnight, when the floor went quiet but the bar stayed lively. Several tables tried a drink from every menu section and loved it. Top sellers: Native Lion, Shinebox, Burner Phone. Door: breezy with a slight fall chill, solid first rush peaking around 8pm at capacity, quieting after 11pm; fun vibes at the door despite one guest trying to touch the iPad. One no-show — a Timeleft app reservation for 8 that only 4 people showed up to, all 30–60 minutes late. Menu count 19/19; one tulip glass broken. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Entered by Stef.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Thursday 9/24 (MOD Marcus; lovely cooler weather).** Total net sales including events $4,761.42 vs target $4,337 (+9.8%); marquee bar sales $5,227.87, garden $0, food $512. Comps $26.80 (community member/investor 10% $4.80, gift item $10, service recovery item $12). 128 guests — 100 walk-in, 28 reservation — at $37.20 net per guest. Steady build with plenty of walk-ins and a couple of 5/6-tops; full by 9pm, tapering after two 6-tops came in around 10pm, slowing by midnight with last call at 12:30am. Tyler and Chaz worked the floor, Ben and Alex held the bar, Devan hosted well, and barback stage Teleia anticipated needs and brought contagious energy. Kitchen solid — discussed oyster prep expectations. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Maintenance: curtain, tin rinser at service. Favorite moment: seeing everyone connect with guests. Entered by Marcus.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Thursday 9/24 (AM Franck & Shannon; PM James & Marcus; overcast and cool).** Total net sales $5,681 vs target $4,387 (+29.5%). Municipal Bar morning $1,297, evening $3,640, Sun Club $37, Hot Eye $789. No food or event sales recorded. Comps $246. 122 guests (6 morning + 116 evening, OpenTable) at $46.57 check average. Fairly slow morning apart from tour groups; Sierra held it down solo before Catie relieved her, with the rest of the team cleaning. Evening started slow for happy hour, then became steady and briefly hectic for the James & Marcus duo before settling down — bar business ran long enough to delay breakdown. Sun Club slow despite nicer weather. Hot Eye quiet with a pop around 10pm from service industry and SCAD regulars back from summer break; team deep-cleaned before open. Kitchen slow until after 8pm, no lows or 86s. Maintenance: Crisalli system behind Municipal Bar malfunctioning (hot/flat water, no temp display) plus a persistent, unexplained leak on the Broughton Street side. No incidents. Favorite moment: SCAD regulars returning from summer break. Entered by Alexis.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.weather: Light drizzle; minor impact on walk-ins
venues.narrative: **SEA — Thursday 9/24 (MOD Julian Abel; light drizzle, minor impact on walk-ins).** Net $11,000 vs target $7,000 (+57.1%). Food $1,700. Comps approximately $220 — about $120 in shift drinks plus roughly a $100 walkout tab from a guest charged for the wrong check. 227 guests at $49.86 check average. Felt like an easy night given the sales volume; Frank kept bar ticket times low and guests left happy. One problematic guest, visiting twice, was asked to leave after becoming disruptive — noted in his SevenRooms profile; left without incident. Made progress ABKing the office/downstairs and secured ginger shochu for the weekend. Kitchen: Josh killed it, with an assist from Anne scooping snacks before 5pm. Maintenance: foot pedal and swing freezer — fridge tech coming tomorrow. Low on cider; throttling the Uwajima Gimlet to conserve for Saturday. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: a couple who met at the D&C EV 10-year anniversary party ten years ago, now living in Seattle together, turned out to be acquaintances of the MOD's. Entered by Julian Abel.
